notes.title: COLD GENERATORS BIOM IS READY!!!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey friends! 👋[/h1][p]
Today’s a big one – we finally wrapped up the [b]Cold Generators[/b] biome! This is a huge milestone for our little team, and honestly, if it weren’t for your constant support and activity, this project wouldn’t even exist. 💖[/p][p]We’ve been absolutely loving your feedback, your crazy gameplay clips, and all the YouTube runs you’ve shared – seriously, [b]THANK YOU[/b]! 🙏
We’re super excited to roll out the updated starting biome for you to explore![/p][p]A lot of our time this month went into behind-the-scenes stuff (which we’re not usually fans of), but the good news is:
[/p][h1][b]🎉 BIG CHANGES:[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Cold Generators Biome is here![/p][p][b][i]6 New Unique Enemies![/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Character Selection System Added![/p][/*][*][p]Sergeant – Can dash[/p][/*][*][p]Captain – Can summon Purge Squad (all with different weapons)[/p][/*][*][p]Fish Treator – Can throw scythe across[/p][/*][*][p]Inquisitor – Can harvest enemies and throw corpses[/p][p][b][i]Huge Balance Changes:[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Player can now buy non-permanent artifacts & weapons (🟨 yellow carpet shop)[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now buy permanent meta-progression gear for next runs (🔴 red carpet trader)[/p][/*][*][p]Experience system added – On reaching max level, a chest appears with 3 artifact choices[/p][/*][*][p]Level-up animation added[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]GAMEPLAY TWEAKS:[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b][i]Challenge #1: Mission Azretea –[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Senator Big Fish Boss added to challenges (replaces Cold Generators boss)[/p][/*][*][p]Big Jellyfish waves added[/p][/*][*][p]Berserk wave added[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]MINOR UPDATES:[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Pause screen added[/p][/*][*][p]Death screen added[/p][/*][*][p]Settings screen added[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]NEXT WEEK:[/b][/h1][p]
We’re jumping back on the content train 🚂 – and if all goes well, you might see some [i]mysterious[/i] new things sneaking into the game… 👀[/p]
